current_openapi.conclusion: The failing per-file route used during diagnosis is absent from the current Access OpenAPI. Current DLCM exposes per-file binary download under DIP resources, while public anonymous dissemination is documented at archive level.

remaining_minimal_diagnostic.reason: Authorized machine went offline before execution.
remaining_minimal_diagnostic.request: After archive download state is READY, obtain the archive-level download-token cookie and send one GET to /access/metadata/{archiveId}/download with Range: bytes=0-1023 using headers-only/streaming mode. If response is 200 instead of 206, dispose immediately without reading the body.

interpretations.200: Archive-level public download works but ignores Range; anonymous use likely requires whole-archive delivery.
interpretations.206: Archive-level public download supports byte ranges; per-file metadata route was the wrong endpoint.
interpretations.500: Archive-level dissemination itself is failing server-side for this archive.
interpretations.401_or_403: Contradicts documented Public archive-download role and would indicate deployment/access-policy mismatch.

experiment_impact: None. No v2 signal data have been inspected; the preregistered protocol and manifest remain unchanged.
